caveats: The credit counter is per user and cumulative; it carries no per-job attribution, so every figure here is derived, not measured.
The account has non-benchmark AI traffic in the same period, so the upper bound overstates benchmark cost.
One conversation is not guaranteed to equal one AI job, so the proportional estimate rests on that assumption.
Deployment validation, probes, and dry runs consumed credits without writing attempt records; they sit in the unattributed remainder.
runs/preserved mirrors runs/sealed-final-v6 and is excluded to avoid double counting its 267 attempts.
method: Omni-routed attempts identified on disk by the marker cost_unavailable_reason=omni_job_api_does_not_expose_cost, which only governed (Omni AI job) attempts carry. C1/C2/C3 write SQL directly and consume no Omni AI credits.
